The best web developer for your business should understand your goals, have proven experience with your preferred platform, and offer more than an attractive website design.

Before hiring, look for these qualities:

  • Real development experience: Check live websites, custom features, and previous projects.
  • Technical knowledge: Look for experience with performance, SEO, security, and integrations.
  • Clear pricing: Understand what’s included, what costs extra, and how revisions work.
  • Communication: Choose someone who explains technical decisions and keeps you updated.
  • Post-launch support: Make sure you know what happens after your website goes live.

At BestWebExpert, you can explore our WordPress plugins, live demos, and development portfolio before making your decision.

A web design agency generally focuses on how a website looks and how visitors interact with it. A web development company focuses on building the functionality behind the design, including custom features, integrations, databases, and technical performance.

Many agencies offer both services, but their technical expertise can vary.

If you need a straightforward business website, a design-focused team may be enough. For custom WordPress functionality, WooCommerce development, Shopify integrations, or complex website requirements, working with experienced developers becomes more important.

BestWebExpert combines website design and development, with a specialized focus on WordPress and Shopify. That means we can handle both the visual experience and the code that makes your website work.

A website builder expert typically works with existing templates, visual editors, and ready-made components to create websites quickly. This can be a practical and affordable option for businesses with straightforward requirements.

A custom web developer can go further by modifying code, building unique functionality, developing integrations, and improving performance beyond the limitations of standard templates.

An experienced WordPress developer should understand more than theme installation and page builders. Look for hands-on knowledge of PHP, WordPress hooks, custom themes, Gutenberg blocks, plugin development, and WooCommerce.

Ask whether they can troubleshoot plugin conflicts, optimize database queries, build custom functionality, and explain how their solutions remain compatible with WordPress updates.

One useful way to verify expertise is to explore actual development work rather than relying entirely on screenshots or testimonials.

BestWebExpert develops WordPress plugins such as ProductReels, ProductBoxes, and MigrateLift. You can explore their features and demonstrations to see examples of our technical work.

Explore our WordPress development services to learn more.

A ready-made Shopify theme is often sufficient for launching a basic online store. Many themes already include responsive layouts, product galleries, collection filters, and essential shopping features.

However, a Shopify expert becomes valuable when your store needs custom functionality or improvements beyond the theme’s built-in options.

For example, a developer can help with:

  • Custom Shopify Liquid sections and product templates
  • Advanced metafields and dynamic content
  • App integrations and custom storefront features
  • Mobile usability and performance improvements
  • Store redesigns and complex migrations

Professional web development services should cover the complete process of planning, designing, building, testing, and launching a website.

A typical project may include website architecture, responsive design, frontend and backend development, performance optimization, essential SEO setup, and integration with relevant business tools.

Before launch, your developer should also test important functions such as contact forms, navigation, checkout flows, and mobile usability. Backup arrangements, security considerations, and analytics setup may also be part of the project.

Most standard WordPress websites take approximately 2–4 weeks, while Shopify stores typically take 3–5 weeks, depending on the project requirements.

A simple business website with a few pages can often be completed faster than an online store with custom features, product imports, third-party integrations, and complex design requirements.

WordPress is usually a strong choice for businesses that need flexible website functionality, content marketing, blogs, appointment bookings, or highly customized pages. With WooCommerce, it can also power fully functional online stores.

Shopify is designed specifically for ecommerce and offers built-in hosting, store management, payment integrations, and a streamlined selling experience.

Choose WordPress if your website needs extensive customization, content flexibility, or features beyond ecommerce. Choose Shopify if selling products is your main priority and you prefer a hosted ecommerce platform.

At BestWebExpert, we work with both, so we can recommend a platform based on your requirements rather than pushing you toward a single solution.

No web developer or SEO agency can honestly guarantee a specific Google ranking. Search rankings depend on multiple factors, including competition, content quality, website authority, relevance, and Google’s ranking systems.

What we can do is build your website with strong technical SEO and on-page SEO foundations.

This includes clean code, responsive layouts, logical heading structures, crawlable pages, appropriate metadata, internal linking, and performance optimization.

We can also help with Google Search Console and analytics setup so you can monitor how your website performs.
